target_justification.nursing_area_level_need: High: zero depth debt, ten explicit shared-science coverage blockers, narrow minimum NP concept cohorts, and a larger safety/currentness surface.
target_justification.cse_deferral_reason: Larger effective pool and lower clinical-safety leverage; retain for a later area-level debt wave.
target_justification.let_deferral_reason: Larger effective pool and residual breadth debt, but lower clinical-safety leverage than Nursing in this milestone.
